## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Jùshě Lùn Sòng Shū Lùn Běn* 俱舍論頌疏論本 (CBETA T41n1823) is a Tang dynasty 30-juan commentary on the *Abhidharmakośa-kārikā* (the verse text [KR6l0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0029), T1560), composed by the monk Yuánhuī 圓暉 ([圓暉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%9A%89)). The title suffix *lùn běn* 論本 ("text of the treatise") indicates that the verse text of the *Kārikā* is incorporated (*běn* 本) within the commentary — a common format in Tang commentary production. The text is the third of the three major Tang commentaries on the *Kośa* (倶舍論三疏), alongside 普光's *jì* ([KR6l0034](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0034)) and 法寶's *shū* ([KR6l0035](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0035)).

**Abstract**

Yuánhuī 圓暉 (fl. Xuánzōng reign 712–756 CE) was a Tang Abhidharma monk who wrote his commentary at Dàyún-sì 大雲寺. Unlike 普光's and 法寶's commentaries (which address the full prose *bhāṣya* text), Yuánhuī's *Sòng Shū* focuses specifically on the verse text (*kārikā*) and offers a more compact, accessible exposition. Because of its relative conciseness and focus on the verses, it became extremely influential in Japan (传 to the Nara period) and in the later East Asian Kōsha (*Kusha*) school tradition, spawning a chain of sub-commentaries: 法盈's *Sòng Shū xùjì* ([KR6l0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0039)), 慧暉's *Sòng Shū yìchāo* ([KR6l0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0040)), 遁麟's *Sòng Shū jì* ([KR6l0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0041)), and the anonymous *Sòng Shū* ([KR6l0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0042)).
